metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code with Struts 1.3 Action entry point (LoanAction.execute()) and Oracle database writes. Single deployable service with servlet container deployment target.
metadata.archetype_justification: Oracle 11g database connection with INSERT operations on user-specific loan application data. CRUD lifecycle with applicant entity persistence.

findings.title: No Machine-Consumable API — Form-Based HTML Only
findings.description: The application exposes only a Struts 1.3 HTML form-based interface mapped to /loan via struts-config.xml. There is no REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. Integration requires UI automation or direct database access.
findings.gap: No machine-consumable API exists. The only integration surface is a Struts Action that renders JSP pages.
findings.recommendation: Create a REST API layer (e.g., Spring Boot or JAX-RS) exposing loan calculation and submission as JSON endpoints.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Create a REST API layer exposing loan operations as JSON endpoints.
blocker_remediation.target_state: RESTful JSON API with documented endpoints for loan pricing and submission.
dependencies: Technology stack modernization required — Java 5/Struts 1.3 cannot host modern REST frameworks.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Write Operations — Duplicate Records on Retry
findings.description: The saveApplication() method performs a plain SQL INSERT with no idempotency key, no unique constraint on business keys, and no deduplication logic. Repeated calls create duplicate loan application records.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism exists. Agent retries or LLM non-determinism would create duplicate loan applications.
findings.recommendation: Add a unique business key and enforce with database UNIQUE constraint. Accept idempotency keys in requests.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency mechanism exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The saveApplication() method performs INSERT without dedup. Agent retries create duplicate loan records.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add unique business key constraint on the applications table.
blocker_remediation.target_state: All write endpoints accept idempotency keys; duplicates return existing record.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication — Container-Managed Only
findings.description: The application relies exclusively on container-managed authentication via request.getRemoteUser() (WebLogic security realm). No OAuth2 client credentials, no API keys, no mTLS, no service accounts.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication mechanism. Agents cannot authenticate as distinct principals.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials or API key authentication with principal attribution.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement API key or OAuth2 client credentials authentication.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Machine identities authenticate via OAuth2 client credentials with unique principal IDs.
dependencies: Requires API surface (API-Q1) and technology modernization.

findings.title: No Audit Logging — Zero Traceability for Write Operations
findings.description: No logging exists in the application — no logging framework, no log statements, no audit trail. Write operations cannot be traced, attributed, or forensically reviewed.
findings.gap: Zero audit logging infrastructure. Agent-initiated write operations are untraceable.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging with principal attribution and immutable storage.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: No logging framework or audit trail. Write operations (loan submissions) have zero traceability.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add structured logging capturing principal, action, and timestamp for every write.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Immutable audit logs with agent principal attribution for all write operations.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback for Write Operations
findings.description: The saveApplication() method performs a single INSERT with no compensation, undo, or rollback capability. No saga patterns, no undo endpoints, no compensating transactions.
findings.gap: No compensation mechanism. Failed multi-step workflows leave partial state.
findings.recommendation: Implement status-based lifecycle (PENDING → CONFIRMED → CANCELLED) for reversibility.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no compensation mechanism exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Direct INSERT with no undo capability. Agent-initiated writes cannot be reversed.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add status column with PENDING state to applications table.
blocker_remediation.target_state: All write operations support compensation via status transitions.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Unscoped — PII and Financial Data Flow Without Filtering
findings.description: System stores PII (applicant names) and financial data (loan details). No field-level filtering, no response DTOs, no access differentiation. Single database credential provides full access.
findings.gap: B1: Sensitive data flows unfiltered through all layers. B2: Single-credential access with no differentiation.
findings.recommendation: Implement response DTOs excluding sensitive fields; create separate OAuth scopes for PII access.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled, B1 fired — sensitive data unscoped in responses.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Applicant PII and financial data flow unfiltered. Single DB credential grants full access.

b1.reasoning: All form fields including applicant name (PII) flow unfiltered to view/database. No field exclusion mechanism.

b2.reasoning: Single database credential (loan_app) for all access. No OAuth scopes or RBAC differentiation.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata (no sensitivity tags, no Macie integration).

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement response DTOs that exclude PII from general responses.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Agent-facing APIs exclude PII by default; sensitive fields via separate scoped endpoints.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls for Financial PII
findings.description: Financial PII stored in Oracle 11g with no documented residency controls. No policies preventing cross-jurisdiction data transmission by agents.
findings.gap: Financial PII without residency controls. Agent could transmit regulated data cross-region.
findings.recommendation: Document residency requirements; enforce at the API boundary.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND financial PII without residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Loan application data (applicant PII, financial terms) stored without residency documentation or cross-region transfer controls.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Document data residency requirements for loan application data.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Explicit residency policy enforced at API layer; cross-region transmission blocked or redacted.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions — All Users Have Identical Access
findings.description: No application-level authorization. Container-managed authentication provides username only. All authenticated users have identical access to all operations.
findings.gap: Cannot scope agent access to specific operations or resources.
findings.recommendation: Implement RBAC distinguishing between read (quote) and write (submit) operations.

compensating_controls: Restrict agent to read-only at orchestration layer
Deploy API Gateway with method-level authorization

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. Action branching (quote vs submit) has no permission checks. Any authenticated user can perform any action.
findings.gap: Cannot restrict agents to specific actions within the same resource.
findings.recommendation: Add action-level permission checks (loan:quote vs loan:submit).

compensating_controls: Implement method-level authorization at API Gateway
Configure agent tool definitions to exclude write operations

findings.title: No Identity Propagation or Delegation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. Single getRemoteUser() string with no structured identity context. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No identity propagation mechanism. No distinction between agent identity modes.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2/JWT with on-behalf-of flow support.

compensating_controls: Pass agent identity in custom headers at API Gateway
Implement token exchange at orchestration layer

findings.title: Hardcoded Database Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: Database credentials hardcoded as static final constants: DB_USER='loan_app', DB_PASS='loanApp2010'. Committed to version control, visible to all with repo access.
findings.gap: Credentials embedded in source code with no secrets management or rotation.
findings.recommendation: Move credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove from git history.

compensating_controls: Immediately rotate the exposed database password
Restrict repository access

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. Only container-managed auth with no application-level identity management.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without platform-wide disruption.
findings.recommendation: Implement agent identity management with individual revocation capability.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway with revocable API keys
Implement Cognito app clients with disable capability

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls — Race Conditions Possible
findings.description: No concurrency controls. Plain SQL INSERT with no optimistic locking, version fields, ETags, or conflict resolution.
findings.gap: No protection against concurrent write operations from multiple agent instances.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking with version fields and unique business key constraints.

compensating_controls: Serialize agent access at orchestration layer
Add database unique constraints as safety net

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configuration. Raw JDBC connection with no resilience. Database unavailability cascades directly to callers.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns. Failures cascade without fallback.
findings.recommendation: Add connection pooling, circuit breakers (Resilience4j), and timeout configuration.

compensating_controls: Configure connection timeouts at JDBC driver level
Implement circuit breaker at API Gateway layer

findings.title: No Rate Limiting at Any Layer
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF, no application-level throttling. Agent traffic storms completely unregulated.
findings.gap: No rate limiting to prevent agent traffic overwhelming the service.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with usage plans and per-caller throttling.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway with throttling
Configure WebLogic connection pool limits

findings.title: No Transaction Limits or Blast Radius Caps
findings.description: No configurable limits on loan application submissions per session/hour/identity. Agent errors could create thousands of records without any business-domain cap.
findings.gap: No business-level transaction limits. Agent blast radius is unbounded.
findings.recommendation: Add per-caller transaction limits (e.g., max 50 submissions per hour per identity).

compensating_controls: Implement per-caller submission limits at API Gateway
Configure agent tool maximum invocation counts

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State — Immediate Commit
findings.description: No draft or pending state. saveApplication() immediately INSERTs into the database. All writes immediately committed with no reviewable intermediate state.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent to propose changes for human review.
findings.recommendation: Add status-based lifecycle (DRAFT → PENDING_REVIEW → APPROVED → SUBMITTED).

compensating_controls: Implement review queue at orchestration layer
Add status column with PENDING state

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gates. Loan submission is single-step with no configurable requirement for human approval before execution.
findings.gap: Cannot require human approval for high-risk operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval rules for loan submissions above thresholds.

compensating_controls: Implement approval gates at agent orchestration layer
Configure amount-based thresholds in agent tool definition

findings.title: No PII Redaction Mechanism
findings.description: No logging framework exists but system processes PII (applicant names, financial data). No PII redaction capability for when logging is added.
findings.gap: No PII protection infrastructure for observability surfaces.
findings.recommendation: Implement PII masking from day one when adding logging infrastructure.

compensating_controls: Include PII masking middleware when implementing logging
Use allowlist-based log field filtering

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy model exists in the repository.
findings.gap: Agent tool definitions cannot be auto-generated. Manual authoring required.
findings.recommendation: Generate OpenAPI spec from annotations when building the new API surface.

compensating_controls: Manually author agent tool definitions
Generate OpenAPI during API development

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No error handling in application code. Exceptions propagate to generic Struts error pages. No structured error codes or retryable classification.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured error responses with code, message, and retryable boolean.

compensating_controls: Implement error classification at API Gateway layer
Map common exceptions to structured responses

findings.title: No Queryable Current State
findings.description: No query endpoints exist. Only INSERT and compute operations. No GET for application status.
findings.gap: Agent cannot inspect current state before acting.
findings.recommendation: Add GET endpoints for loan application status as part of REST API.

compensating_controls: Query Oracle database directly
Add read endpoints during API modernization

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: Testing uses a shared UAT environment per README. No containerized local env, no seed data scripts, no isolated sandbox.
findings.gap: No isolated sandbox for safe agent testing.
findings.recommendation: Create containerized local environment with synthetic loan data.

compensating_controls: Use existing shared UAT with restricted agent access
Create Docker-based local environment

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection Vulnerability
findings.description: No input validation. SQL injection via string concatenation of applicantName directly into SQL. No validation.xml, no parameterized queries for user input.
findings.gap: Arbitrary input accepted without validation. Active SQL injection vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries immediately. Implement input validation with structured error responses.

compensating_controls: Implement input validation at API Gateway
Use parameterized queries immediately

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata or Freshness Signaling
findings.description: No temporal metadata. INSERT has no timestamp columns. No timezone handling, no freshness signaling.
findings.gap: Agent cannot reason about data freshness.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at and updated_at UTC timestamp columns.

compensating_controls: Add database triggers for automatic timestamps
Include timestamps in new API responses

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, no API contracts, no changelog, no breaking change detection. Unversioned /loan path.
findings.gap: No versioned contracts. Changes break integrations silently.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning and schema change detection in CI.

compensating_controls: Pin agent tool definitions to current behavior
Implement versioning from day one

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No distributed tracing, no structured logging, no correlation IDs. Zero observability instrumentation.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated requests cannot be traced or correlated.
findings.recommendation: Add OpenTelemetry SDK with trace ID propagation and JSON logging.

compensating_controls: Instrument at API Gateway layer
Add X-Ray tracing during modernization

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No alerting configuration. No CloudWatch alarms, no monitoring, no anomaly detection.
findings.gap: Service degradation invisible to agent consumers.
findings.recommendation: Deploy CloudWatch alarms on error rates and p99 latency.

compensating_controls: Monitor from API Gateway layer
Implement synthetic monitoring

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual Solaris/WebLogic/Oracle infrastructure. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or Ansible.
findings.gap: No IaC, no peer review of infra changes, no drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Define target infrastructure as IaC during cloud migration.

compensating_controls: Document current infrastructure configuration
Implement IaC during cloud migration

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Manual WAR upload via WebLogic admin console. No automated testing.
findings.gap: No pipeline to detect API-breaking changes before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with API contract testing.

compensating_controls: Manual API testing checklist
Set up basic CI with contract validation

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback capability. Manual WAR re-upload is the only recovery path. No blue/green, no canary, no feature flags.
findings.gap: Cannot quickly roll back breaking deployments.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green deployment with automatic rollback triggers.

compensating_controls: Maintain previous WAR files for manual rollback
Implement during cloud migration

findings.title: Zero Automated Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests. README confirms no unit tests. Testing is a shared UAT environment only.
findings.gap: No automated verification of API behavior.
findings.recommendation: Implement API test suite covering input handling, error responses, and edge cases.

compensating_controls: Implement integration tests with new API
Use Postman/Newman for validation

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Oracle 11g on Solaris with no TDE or KMS configuration. Loan data stored unencrypted.
findings.gap: Sensitive loan data at rest unencrypted.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to AWS RDS/Aurora with KMS encryption at rest.

compensating_controls: Enable Oracle TDE if supported
Migrate to encrypted RDS/Aurora

findings.title: Response Format Is HTML — Not Machine-Consumable
findings.description: Responses are HTML via JSP rendering. No JSON, XML, or structured API responses.
findings.gap: Current format not suitable for LLM/agent consumption.
findings.recommendation: Use JSON as response format for the new REST API surface.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. Loan submissions do not trigger events, webhooks, or notifications.
findings.gap: State changes invisible to external observers. Polling required for event-driven patterns.
findings.recommendation: Add event emission (SNS/EventBridge) for loan lifecycle events when modernizing.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented or enforced. No rate limit headers returned to callers.
findings.gap: Agents have no signal to self-throttle.
findings.recommendation: Document and return rate limit headers when deploying API Gateway.

findings.title: No Data Quality Metrics or Monitoring
findings.description: No data quality metrics, profiling, or monitoring for the loan applications data store.
findings.gap: No visibility into data completeness or reliability.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring when migrating to managed database.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer. Schema discoverable only by reading INSERT statements in source code.
findings.gap: No formal metadata describing the data store.
findings.recommendation: Document schema formally. Consider Glue Data Catalog after database migration.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of operations >30s. Loan calculation is instantaneous and INSERT is a single synchronous database call.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority specified and service is not identified as critical path.

evaluations.title: Selective Query Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no list/query endpoints with potentially unbounded results exist. Only INSERT and compute operations.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names are semantically meaningful: applicant, principal, rate, term, officer (DB columns); getPrincipal(), getAnnualRate(), getTermMonths(), getApplicantName() (Java methods). No legacy abbreviations.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry of any kind emitted — no observability surface to assess. Informational-absence suppression applies.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and highest-priority RISK-SAFETY findings. Focus on API surface creation, machine identity, audit logging, and data protection controls.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings. Build observability, engineering maturity, and infrastructure governance.
Complete quality improvements: test coverage, event emission, rate limit documentation, data quality monitoring.

recommended_actions.action: Modernize technology stack and create REST API surface
recommended_actions.rationale: Java 5/Struts 1.3 cannot host modern REST frameworks. Technology modernization is prerequisite for all other remediations.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity provider with machine identity support
recommended_actions.rationale: Machine identity is the foundation for all authorization, audit, and blast-radius controls.

recommended_actions.action: Implement immutable audit logging with principal attribution
recommended_actions.rationale: Write-enabled agent scope requires full audit trail. Must implement PII redaction concurrently.
Hardcoded credentials are an immediate security vulnerability. Quick win with high impact.

recommended_actions.action: Implement data residency controls and classification
recommended_actions.rationale: Financial PII requires documented residency controls before any agent can access the data.

recommended_actions.action: Add rate limiting, transaction limits, and circuit breakers
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents agent traffic storms and limits blast radius of agent errors.
Write-enabled agents require reversibility and human oversight for high-stakes operations.
